note: Paragraphs Report inventories which paragraph types are used on which nodes. Settings persist in paragraphs_report.settings (content_types checkbox map, hide_paras, import_rows_per_batch default 10, watch_content bool). Report DATA lives in the key-value collection paragraph_report.report_data (key 'data'), not config. Drush 'paragraphs_report:update' (alias pru). Report page /admin/reports/paragraphs-report (route paragraphs_report.report, the configure route); settings tab /admin/reports/paragraphs-report/settings. Medium cases seed known settings values and read them back; hard cases require setting content_types/watch_content/import_rows_per_batch, verified against live config. Baselines restored to install defaults (content_types {}, import_rows_per_batch 10, watch_content false).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the Paragraphs Report module, which Drush command rebuilds the paragraphs usage report, and what is its alias?
evals.expected_output: drush paragraphs_report:update (alias: drush pru). It scans the configured content types and stores usage in the key-value report data.

evals.prompt: Where is the Paragraphs Report in the Drupal admin, and which configuration object / key controls which content types are scanned?
evals.expected_output: Report is at /admin/reports/paragraphs-report (route paragraphs_report.report); the content types to scan are in paragraphs_report.settings under the content_types key (settings tab at /admin/reports/paragraphs-report/settings).

evals.prompt: In Paragraphs Report, what does the 'Watch for content changes' option do, and which config key represents it?
evals.expected_output: When enabled (config key watch_content = true), node insert/update/delete automatically update the report data for the selected content types, so you do not have to rerun the report manually.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Paragraphs Report batch size has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state how many nodes it processes per batch.
The Paragraphs Report on this site is configured to scan one content type. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of the content type it reports on.
Configure the Paragraphs Report module to report on the 'article' content type and to automatically keep the report up to date whenever content changes. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In paragraphs_report.settings, include 'article' in content_types (as article => article) and set watch_content to TRUE.

evals.prompt: The Paragraphs Report keeps timing out because our pages have lots of components. In the report settings, change the number of nodes processed per batch to 50. Apply the change to the live site.
